    private static long[] nttmb(long[] src, int n, boolean inverse, int P, int g) {

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[i] = modh(dst[i] * in, M, H, P);
        }

        return dst;
    }

    private static long[] garnerPrepare(int[] m) {
        int n = m.length;
        assert n == m.length;

            gamma[k] = invl(prod, m[k]);

    private static long[] garnerBatch(int[] u, int[] m, long[] gamma) {
        int n = u.length;
        assert n == m.length;
        long[] v = new long[n];

        for (int k = 1; k < n; k++) {
            long temp = v[k - 1];
            for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                temp = (temp * m[j] + v[j]) % m[k];
            }
            v[k] = (u[k] - temp) * gamma[k] % m[k];
            if (v[k] < 0) v[k] += m[k];

        return v;

        return ret;

        long b = mod;
        long p = 1, q = 0;
        while (b > 0) {
            long c = a / b;
            long d;
            d = a;
            a = b;
            b = d % b;
            d = p;
            p = q;
            q = d - c * q;
        }
        return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
    }

        char[] buf = new char[n];

    }

        char[][] map = new char[n][];

    }

    private int[] na(int n) {
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = ni();

    }

    private int ni() {
        int num = 0, b;

        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
        if (b == '-') {

            b = readByte();

            } else {

            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }

            } else {

            }
            b = readByte();
        }
    }
